name: valxon-academy
description: VALXON Academy – import dodavatelů a sedmidílná výuková prezentace (standalone monorepo).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @valxon/api && npm run build -w @valxon/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,gray "npm run start:prod -w @valxon/api" "npm run start -w @valxon/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @valxon/api && npm run typecheck -w @valxon/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @valxon/api && npm run lint -w @valxon/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @valxon/api && npm run test -w @valxon/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
